'''Hybrid plexisteel''' was a raw material used in [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] construction. During the [[rawmat shortage of 1–2 ABY]], hybrid plexisteel was one of the materials that had become scarce.<ref name="GNN7">{{JournalCite|7|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
